description: Use for today's complete live picture in one paid call: the latest published BTC Intel Score (0–100) and its classification, its historical position (the share of recorded days below and above it, daily since July 2011, backtested with the current method before live publication), and the five market areas (Technical, On-chain, Market structure, Sentiment, Macro), each with its state, position on the five-step scale and last change. Not for a past day (use get_score_for_day), a range of days (get_score_history), statistics (get_score_statistics) or the market areas alone (free: get_bitcoin_today or get_market_detail). Context, not a forecast. $0.25 per call in bitcoin over Lightning, one payment per answer, no subscription: the first call returns an invoice instead of data (steps under payment). Research, not investment advice.

payment.description: Omit on the first call: it returns a Lightning invoice (valid 10 minutes) and a macaroon instead of data. Pay it, then call again with payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>" (the preimage your wallet shows once paid) within 24 hours. One payment buys one answer; a used, expired or wrong proof is refused with the reason; call again without payment for a new invoice.

name: get_score_live

dates.description: score (the Score date) and market_edition (UTC), named apart, with a note

history.description: Historical position: pct_below and pct_above (shares of recorded days), days, since, rank (one sentence), level_share_pct, level_since, note

invoice.description: The Lightning invoice to pay (call without payment)

level.description: Its classification: Low, Moderate-low, Neutral, Elevated or High

macaroon.description: The token to send back with the preimage (call without payment)

market.description: The five market areas: scale, as_of / edition_at (UTC), and areas[] with area, state, position (1–5), of, explanation, last_change, link

payment_required.description: True on a call without payment

score.description: The latest published BTC Intel Score, whole number as on the site

score_date.description: The date the Score is for (YYYY-MM-DD), the latest published day

title: Live snapshot: Score, history and the five areas (paid)
